description: The ARMADAS structural result: robotically assembled injection-molded CF-nylon voxel lattice, 3x3x3 assemblies tested in compression. The measured numbers this project leans on: strength 11.17 kPa with failure AT the fastener before strut buckling, stiffness 1.1129 MPa at 10.285 kg/m3, and (in the supplement) the voxel mass breakdown that puts fasteners plus bolts at 27.8% of assembled mass. 29 pages, author accepted manuscript.
